resources.string: Habits are things you do, or avoid, any number of times. Tap + after a good one and − after a slip.
Dailies repeat on a schedule. Each one you miss costs a little health when the new day starts.
To-dos are one-off tasks. The longer one waits, the more it pays when you finally do it.
Spend your gold on real treats: a coffee, an episode, a lazy morning.
It disappears from your board. The XP and gold it gave you stay.
These dailies weren\'t ticked yesterday. Did you do any of them after all? Tick what you finished; the rest will cost a little health.
You lost a level and your gold. Your gear and pets are safe. Rest, then try again: one small task is enough to start.
You reached level %d. Health fully restored.
New gear is waiting in the shop.
%1$s is defeated. You earned %2$s gold, %3$s XP and: %4$s.
Strength: harder hits on bosses and more critical hits
Intelligence: more experience from every task
Constitution: less damage from slips and missed dailies
Perception: more gold and more drops
Finish tasks to find eggs, potions and food. Combine an egg with a potion to hatch a pet.
No food yet: find it on tasks or buy it in the shop
Heals %s HP for every finished task
Feed pets to grow them: a grown companion helps twice as much. Their favourite food grows them faster.
Every task you finish hits the boss. Every daily you miss lets it hit back.
The boss will heal. You can challenge it again any time.
Hits for about %s per missed daily
No fight right now. Pick a boss below: it turns your tasks into attacks.
Holiday or sick day? Missed dailies won\'t hurt and streaks are kept.
Night owl? Dailies roll over at this hour instead of midnight.
The reminders you set on dailies and to-dos
A nudge when dailies are still open
Some phones (Xiaomi, Huawei, Samsung…) stop apps in the background. Allow autostart and turn off battery restrictions for Dayquest.
So your reminders can reach you.
There are no accounts: your hero lives on this phone. To continue on another device, send yourself a file or a code and import it there.
Code copied. On the other phone open Settings → Move your progress → Paste code.
Everything in Dayquest on this phone will be replaced by the imported progress.
That doesn\'t look like Dayquest progress
Dayquest is free and open source. No ads, no premium, no account; everything stays on your device.
Turn your days into a quest
Build habits, tick off dailies, clear your to-dos. Your hero levels up, finds pets and defeats bosses. Slack off, and the hero gets hurt.
Small is good. Everything can be changed later.
Tick it off for XP and gold.
There is still time before the day ends.
A wobbly monarch who grows fat on dirty dishes and unmade beds. Tidy up and pop him.
He steals your time one \"later\" at a time. Do it now and he loses his grip.
Heavy, slow and very hard to move, just like the task you keep putting off.
Its icy breath freezes good intentions. Keep moving to stay warm.
It whispers that you can\'t. Every finished task proves it wrong.
The last foe feeds on pushing too hard. Steady days beat heroic sprints.
From level 20, every 5 levels the forge offers a new tier of gear. It never runs out.

Seasons follow the calendar. Turn this on if winter comes in July for you.

resources.string: It wanders in for one week only. Beat it before Sunday ends; a new one arrives every Monday.
It wakes every spring from the piles you never sorted. Clear a shelf and its branches wither.
Sunbathing all day, it pinches anyone who tries to get up. Move a little every day.
Autumn blues with a carved grin. Small finished tasks light up the evenings.
It wants you under a blanket until March. Keep your dailies and stay warm.
Your hero\'s room. Furnish it with the gold you earn: every piece has a place.
Your habits keep a hero alive
Everything you do in real life moves this little hero. Finish things and it earns experience and gold and levels up. Slack off and it loses health.
Habits: tap + after a good one, − after a slip. As often as you like.
Dailies: repeat on a schedule. Tick them before the day ends.
To-dos: one-off tasks. The longer they wait, the more they pay.
Experience levels you up and fully heals you. Gold buys your own rewards, gear and furniture. Tasks sometimes drop eggs, potions and food: combine an egg with a potion to hatch a pet.
Start a quest and every task you finish hits the boss. Each daily you miss lets it hit back at the start of a new day. Beat it for gold and rare loot.

Each morning you can tick off what you did yesterday but forgot to mark. Every tap can be undone. Ill or on holiday? Rest at the inn and nothing hurts. No account: your hero moves to a new phone with a file or a code.
Tap the square when a daily or to-do is done, and + or − on habits. Each tap shows what it gave and can be undone. Missed dailies cost health when a new day starts.
Gold buys three things here: your own real-life rewards, gear that raises your stats (try it on first), food for your pets, and new places for your hero.

Eggs and hatching potions drop from finished tasks. Pick one of each to hatch a pet and take it along: every companion helps in its own way and sometimes brings back food overnight. Feed it until it is fully grown to double its help.
Start a fight: from then on every task you finish hits the boss, and every daily you miss lets it hit back. A new boss of the week comes every Monday.
Change your look, swap gear, furnish your home and follow your achievements. Rest at the inn pauses damage when life gets in the way.
It spins a web of feeds and videos and waits for you to get stuck. Put the phone down and walk away.
Every tentacle is a ping that pulls you off course. Finish one thing before you answer the next.
It looks like a treasure chest and eats your gold. Wait a day before every “I need it now”.
Half-done projects rattle its chains at night. Close one loop at a time and it fades.
He won’t let anything leave the forge until it’s flawless. Done is better than perfect.
Say yes to one thing and two more heads appear. Learning to say no is the sharpest blade.
She buzzes about all day and nothing gets done. Pick what matters and the hive goes quiet.
It grows wherever things sit still for too long. Air out the room and your routine.
It floats wherever the tide takes it, and so will you if you let it. Set a course for the day.
Its sting is every harsh word you say to yourself. Be kind to the hero doing the work.
It looks scary from afar and is stuffed with straw up close. Start, and the fear falls apart.
It keeps you scrolling past midnight and steals tomorrow’s energy. Go to bed on time.
He stands still all winter and wants you to do the same. A short walk melts him a little.
He rules a cosy iceberg where nothing new ever happens. Try one small new thing.
A garden behind the cottage under the real sky: it changes with the time of day and the seasons.
A cosy room under the roof with a round window. Furnish it however you like.
Every daily is done. This chest is yours.
Quiet when the phone is on silent or vibrate.
It decides how much missed tasks hurt. You can change it any time in settings.
Half the damage. Fainting costs half your gold, never a level.
The classic: misses hurt, fainting costs a level and all your gold.
50% more damage, but 25% more XP and gold.
Health potions cost half price today.
Every task pays double gold today.
A goblin snatched 5 gold! Finish 3 tasks to catch him and get 15 back.
Your hits deal +50% damage to the boss.
Eggs, potions and food drop much more often.
+15% chance of a critical hit on the boss.
Perfect weather for routines: dailies pay +50%.
A healer passes by and restores 15 health.
Bad habits and today\'s missed dailies hurt half as much.
Finish 5 tasks to dig up 25 gold.
Food makes pets grow twice as fast.
Streak bonuses on dailies are doubled.
Your first task today pays triple.
A stork drops off a mystery egg.
An alchemist leaves you a hatching potion.
Double damage to the boss, but bad habits hurt 50% more.
Finish 3 tasks to find a mystery egg.
Every task has a 15% chance to pay 5× gold.
+25% XP and gold from every task.
10 gold fell from the sky right into your purse.
Finish 8 tasks: 40 gold and a hatching potion.
Strength grows twice as fast. Smashes bosses and shrugs off damage.
Intelligence grows twice as fast. More XP, more mana, fireballs.
Perception grows twice as fast. More gold, more finds, and streaks that slip through the night.
Constitution grows twice as fast. Heals, and keeps the bad nights gentle.
At level %d you choose a class: one stat grows twice as fast, and you get skills that cost mana.
Your class\'s stat grows twice as fast, and it brings three skills that cost mana. Mana comes back with every finished task and overnight.
A change costs %s gold and empties your mana.
+15% critical chance until the day ends.
Bad habits today and missed dailies tonight hurt half as much.
Hits the boss for %1$s and gives %2$s XP.
+30% XP from every task until the day ends.
The boss can\'t strike back tonight.
+15% item chance and two more finds today.
Missed dailies keep their streaks tonight.
Every task finished today heals 2 health.
Bad habits today and missed dailies tonight hurt four times less.
Turns a fully grown pet into a mount: it carries you in the scene and gives its perk in full, on top of your companion\'s.
Needs a saddle: buy one in the shop or find one at the end of the weekend dungeon.
Grow a pet to full size and saddle it to ride it.
Open on Saturdays and Sundays. Every finished task is a step deeper (hard ones count twice). Each room pays; the last one hides a chest and a saddle.
Cleared! A new dungeon opens next weekend.
The keeper of the depths falls. You carry out %1$s gold, a chest and a saddle.
Grows with every success and sinks with every miss: red is neglected, blue is mastered.
Nothing here yet: finish this task a few times and its story appears.
Pick a mood on the task board once a day. After a few weeks you\'ll see how your mood and your days go together.
On good days you finish %1$s tasks on average, on hard days %2$s.
Put the phone down and work on one thing. A finished session pays like a task (the longer, the better) and counts as a step in the weekend dungeon. Leaving early pays nothing.
%1$d minutes of focus: +%2$s XP and %3$s gold.
Come back to collect your reward.
Heroes travel as codes, no account needed. Swap codes with friends: everyone whose card is less than a week old gives +2% XP and gold, up to +10%.
No one here yet. Send your code to a friend and ask for theirs.
The card is over a week old: ask for a fresh one
Your code changes as your hero grows. Send a fresh one every week or so, and ask friends to do the same: fresh cards keep the party bonus going.
Food grows it half as much again.
Brings something home overnight more often.
As your companion: +5% damage to bosses.
As your companion: +2% chance to find items.
As your companion: +3% XP from tasks.
Friendship grows half as fast again.
For 30 days together as your companion, each with a finished task. Night-blue fur full of stars.
For 10 bosses beaten together as your companion. War paint and a plated belly.
A grown pet can evolve once, down one of two roads. An evolved pet helps a quarter more.
This is for good: the other road closes for this pet.
Give your pet a name. Leave it empty to go back to its kind and colour.
Best friends. Its help is a fifth stronger for good.
At 10 hearts: best friends, and its help grows stronger.
Already patted today. Tap it in the scene for more hearts anyway.
Friendship grows with every day together, every treat and every boss you beat side by side. Tap your companion in the scene to pat it. Three hearts teach it a trick, ten make it your best friend.
Bows, hats, scarves and glasses for pets are sold in the shop.
Bought once, worn by any pet: on the stable card tap a piece to put it on or take it off.
Seen in the scene, at home and in the stable.
Hatch every colour of one kind, or every kind in one colour. A finished collection pays gold and a title; a full kind also earns a statue for your home.
Shown under your name. Tap to change.
Three hearts. Now and then %s does a flip in the scene, and a pat sets it off.
Six hearts. %s brings you a friendship ribbon: any pet can wear it (stable → wardrobe).
Ten hearts. %s is your best friend now, and its help is a fifth stronger for good.
%s can evolve. Pick its road on its card in the stable.

plurals.name: note_missed
plurals.item: You were gone for a day. I waited by the door and kept your spot warm. I\'m so glad you\'re back!
You were gone for %d days. I waited by the door every evening. Never mind, you\'re back now, and that\'s what matters!

string-array.name: note_found
string-array.item: While you slept I found %1$s %2$s. It\'s for you!
Look what I dug up %2$s: %1$s!
I went for a little walk %2$s and came back with %1$s.
%1$s! I found it %2$s and carried it all the way home.

string-array.name: note_places
string-array.item: by the stream
under the old oak
in the tall grass
behind the mossy stone
over the hill
in the bushes
by the garden fence
down the path

string-array.name: note_bond
string-array.item: I think we\'re getting closer. Yesterday was a good day together.
You did so much yesterday. I\'m proud to walk beside you.
Another heart! I knew we\'d make a good team.

string-array.name: note_rain
string-array.item: It rained all night. I hid under a big leaf and listened to the drops.
The rain drummed on the roof. I curled up and dreamed of sunshine.
Puddles everywhere this morning! Can we jump in them later?

string-array.name: note_snow
string-array.item: It snowed in the night! I left little footprints all around the house.
Everything is white outside. I caught a snowflake on my nose.

string-array.name: note_glutton
string-array.item: I dreamed of a mountain of cake. Do we have any cake?
Good morning! Is it breakfast yet? It feels like breakfast.
I only ate a little bit of the berries. Well, most of them.

string-array.name: note_sleepy
string-array.item: I slept all evening. And a little more this morning. Five more minutes?
Mmm… morning already? I\'ll walk with you, just slowly.
I had the coziest dream. You were in it, finishing all your tasks.

string-array.name: note_brave
string-array.item: I kept watch all night. No monsters came. They know I\'m here.
Ready for today! Whatever comes, I\'ve got your back.
I practised growling at shadows. I\'m getting really good at it.

string-array.name: note_curious
string-array.item: Did you know there\'s a beetle living under the doorstep? We\'re friends now.
I found a new smell by the fence. I must investigate today.
What\'s on the list today? I want to see everything!

string-array.name: note_cheerful
string-array.item: Good morning! Today is going to be a great day, I can feel it!
The sun is up and so am I. Let\'s go!
I did a little dance when I woke up. You should try it.

string-array.name: note_loyal
string-array.item: I slept right by your door. Just in case you needed me.
Wherever you go today, I\'m coming too.
You\'re my favourite person. That\'s all. Good morning.

resources.string: Big moments keep a picture of the scene just as it was: hatchings, wins, perfect days, best friends.
Nothing here yet. Hatch a pet or beat a boss and the first picture appears.
